item.title: FriedChillies Fest: Dive into 11 Epic Seafood Dishes That Will Blow Your Mind This Weekend!
item.description: Seafood lovers, are you feeling lost in a sea of generic seafood restaurants? Tired of the same old seafood that doesn't quite hit the spot? Come on to the FriedChillies Seafood Fest this weekend, 22-23 June at Sunway Putra Mall for 15 of the best seafood in one location! Curated by FriedChillies of course. With combo's and promo's in the works, it's all gonna be at wallet friendly prices too!

item.title: Siapa Ready for Nasi Kandaq Fest 2.0? The Ultimate Nasi Kandar Festival is Back in KL!
item.description: Perhatian peminat nasi kandar semua! Guess what? We're doing it again, and this time, Nasi Kandaq Fest 2.0 will be lagi Suurrrr (that means lagi Sedap la), with new and returning legends. Save the date! 21-22 September 2024 at Sunway Putra Mall, Kuala Lumpur.

item.title: Nasi Kandaq Fest 2.0: 11 Nasi Kandar Terbaik Penang, Ipoh, KL & JB Under One Roof
item.description: Perhatian Peminat Nasi Kandaq Semua! For all you "kuah campoq" fans, this is THE fest you’ve been waiting for. Get ready for a nasi kandar showdown like no other because the Nasi Kandaq Fest 2.0 .nasi kandar legends are about to take over Sunway Putra Mall, KL this 21-22 September 2024! Jangan Terlepas Peluang Ni!

item.title: ieatNasiLemak X Road to Unesco - Celebrating Our Heritage
item.description: Fans of ‘I Eat Nasi Lemak’, we're back! Malaysia is on it's way to make Malaysian Breakfast Culture a World Heritage with nasi lemak, roti canai & teh tarik as the breakfast! Of course we need to celebrate with ieatNasiLemak! Get ready to satisfy your craving for Malaysia’s favourite breakfast choice with 5 nasi lemak heroes and 2 roti canai & teh tarik legends at the the "Road to Unesco - Celebrating our Heritage" event this 5th and 6th October 2024 at Subang Parc, Subang Jaya.

item.title: ieatNasiLemak is Back For This Weekend Only! Don't MISS OUT!
item.description: I Eat Nasi Lemak returns as part of the Road to Unesco - Celebrating Our Heritage event on 5th to 6th October 2024 at Subang Parc, Subang Jaya. Fans who have been awaiting this comeback will be pleased to know that we are bringing together 5 Nasi Lemak Heroes that are known across the Klang Valley in one location so you can try them all at the same time, just like last time!

item.title: Makan Lejen x Keretapi Sarong — Everyone Came. Everyone Ate. Everyone Had Fun!
item.description: KL got a full-on flavor earthquake and we loved every second of it. Makan Lejen x Keretapi Sarong at Raintree TRX was everything we promised: sarong-clad crowds, proper makan heritage, and a whole lot of “Fuhhh, sedaplah!” Energy was crazy — roughly 25,000+ of you showed up!

item.title: Come for the Coffee, Stay for the Community at FriedChillies x SelCoff 2025!
item.description: Korang yang kaki kopi, mark your calendar! The Selangor Coffee Festival (SelCoff 2025) is coming in hot this 17–19 October at The Curve, Petaling Jaya .It’s more than just espresso and latte art. Meet old friends, make new ones, share stories, swap beans — and feel what Malaysia’s growing coffee family is really about.

item.title: NKF 3.0: Jarang Sangat Kita Dapat Lineup Lejen Nasi Kandar Macam Ni
item.description: Nasi Kandaq Fest 3.0 is taking over Datum Jelatek Shopping Centre on 29–30 November (10am-10pm), and the lineup this year? Serious business, boss! We’re bringing together 9 nasi kandar lejens from Penang, KL and Johor — semua heavy hitters, all fan favourites, Gerenti “Surrrrrr!” This year is extra special because we’re also partnering with Datum Jelatek Shopping Centre to celebrate their 3rd Anniversary.

item.title: People Actually Drive North for THIS - Nasi Kandar Included
item.description: Drive Utara ni ramai orang buat. Tapi yang buat dia seronok - bila kau tahu mana nak makan best. Kalau korang jenis macam kita yang drive sambil fikir pasal makan, this article is for you. Nasi Kandar, R&R and hidden food spots included!

item.title: Balik KL Tapi Jangan Terus Drive Balik - Hidden Food Gems Ramai Tak Tahu
item.description: It's been two days kita drive roadtrip makan best from KL to Alor Setar and our latest stop was Nasi Natrah stall, Penang pekena nasi kandar with kari ikan biji nangka. Hari ni - kita dah nak balik KL, tapi jangan terus balik tau.
